name: grouped_hub_two_phones
description: The hub is grouped and already holds the iPhone's records. The iPhone links and resumes from its stored watermark. An ungrouped Android links next: the hub hands it the key (JOIN from the peripheral), both pull. Then live pushes: an iPhone rename goes I->H {I,H} and H->A {I,H,A}; an Android rename goes A->H->I; an Android-heard packet takes route 2 (via the hub) to the iPhone. LIVE_PULL re-pulls follow 2 s after each live record.
